_comment: One entry per project. kind: core | homebrew | tool. asset: glob of the release file to offer (default: the first .zip, else .bin, never a 'debug' one). web: a page to open instead of a download. upstream: the repo this one is a fork of (its version is shown next to it). bios: BIOS files the core reads, {dir, files, optional, included (shipped in the zip), when {en,es} (only for some games)} -- the core's header does not say. official: listed in the firmware's README by sylverb ('in the installer' is read from installer-retro-go-sd's packages.list). data: 'own' = needs the original game's files, 'free' = needs game files that are free to download. versions.json is written by .github/workflows/versions.yml.
